8165: When adding permissions, software should update and invalidate the HPT table entries before
8166: updating translation tables. This avoids unintended faults if the device immediately accesses the
8167: permitted addresses.
8168: 1. Change HPT to add permissions as needed
8169: 2. HPT invalidation
8170: 3. Change translation tables as needed
8171: 4. IOTLB invalidation, if required by translation table changes
8172: 5. DevTLB invalidation, if required by translation table changes
8173: 
8174: 6.5.3.5         Optional Invalidation
8175: The following items describe cases in which software may choose not to invalidate the IOTLB when
8176: modifying first-level paging entries, and the potential consequences of that choice:
8177:  • If a paging-structure entry is modified to change the P flag from 0 to 1, no invalidation is
8178:    necessary. This is because no IOTLB entry or paging-structure cache entry is created with
8179:    information from a paging-structure entry in which the P flag is 01.
8180:  • If a paging-structure entry is modified to change the accessed flag from 0 to 1, no invalidation is
8181:    necessary (assuming that an invalidation was performed the last time the accessed flag was
8182:    changed from 1 to 0). This is because no IOTLB entry or paging-structure cache entry is created
8183:    with information from a paging-structure entry in which the accessed flag is 0.
8184:  • If a paging-structure entry is modified to change the R/W flag from 0 to 1, and the entry is used
8185:    only by requests that can tolerate recoverable translation faults (see Section 7.4), failure to
